scientific_unit.grouped_cv_rule: both members of a counterfactual group must remain in the same fold
scientific_unit.duplicate_seed_outcomes: retained within state aggregation but never counted as independent states

feature_contract.inputs: only visible pre-action state, exact Rank-1 candidate, compiler metadata, retrieval descriptor, and current resource budget
forbidden: human quality, risk, or functional-use annotations
raw state, user, candidate, memory, strategy, action, or condition identifier

primary_model.group_weight: each counterfactual group has total training weight one before class balancing

transparent_rule_baseline.MP: incremental and no scope conflict and either preference scope fit >= 0.5 or relevant current-owner profile fit >= 0.5
transparent_rule_baseline.MS: incremental, not resolved, goal fit >= 0.5, and a specific prior issue/distinction/outcome exists
transparent_rule_baseline.ME: incremental, goal fit >= 0.5, contains an action, and contains a result or mechanism
transparent_rule_baseline.RS: mode, goal, burden, boundary, and nonredundancy are each >= 0.5

hard_label.positive: across two frozen seeds, at least one ON material win, no OFF material win, no uncertain quality, and no material ON-arm grounding risk
hard_label.nonpositive: all other adjudicable outcomes, including ties because incremental prompt cost is nonzero
hard_label.uncertain_sensitivity: quality or risk uncertain is nonpositive in primary and excluded in sensitivity
hard_label.functional_use: secondary mechanism outcome only and never an ITT validity filter
hard_label.fallback: retained as assigned ON treatment outcome

challenger.role: one frozen representation challenger, never label source

timing_disclosure: The feature names and model family were already fixed in the final candidate contract and research plan before generation. This manifest materializes their exact rows, class weighting, fold seeds, and semantic grouping after response generation but before any FIT human outcome labels; it does not read generated responses or execution outcomes.
